name: (03) Thaumaturgy (Path of Shadowcrafting) — 2 Intermediate — Coruscating Shadow

system.description:
The Tremere peels shade from the surrounding surfaces and bends it into a whirling globe of darkness that spins about them at arm's length, confounding every eye that tries to follow.

Indicate the power by crossing your arms at neck level, palms out with fingers spread, an unmistakable sight to any onlooker. The strobing sphere grants you one bonus Trait to resolution in all challenges of stealth and when defending against any physical attack. It lasts for one turn for every Trait of permanent Willpower you possess. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
system.duration: One turn per point of permanent Willpower
